title: Borrow Views for Substrings
goal: Extract a domain from an email address without allocating fresh strings.
hints: The domain string segment already exists inside the input `email` slice.
Returning `&str` hands back a view tied to the input lifetime, requiring zero allocations.
explanation: Returning `&str` borrows directly from `email`, resulting in zero heap allocations or clones. Returning `String` fails type checks when a zero-copy `&str` view is required by caller APIs. Attempting to create an intermediate `String` inside the function and return a borrow to it fails to compile because the local buffer is dropped at function exit.
